name: longPress (2000ms)
description: Mirrors GestureHelper.longPress(element, 2000) in utils/gestureHelper.ts. Coordinates default to screen center (50%,50%) as a placeholder - after importing, drag the tick's dot on the screenshot (or edit x/y in the tick card) to the center of the element you actually want to long-press, e.g. read its bounds from Inspector's Box Model panel.
